installCommand: if [ -d "flutter" ]; then cd flutter && git pull && cd ..; else git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable flutter; fi && flutter/bin/flutter precache --web && flutter/bin/flutter pub get
buildCommand: if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release
